title: Start inquiry negotiation transactionally
requirements: Add only a transactional OwnerCommandService.start_negotiation command for the accepted START_NEGOTIATION transition. Its semantic payload is exactly expected_version and expected_visit_versions as an empty mapping; it changes NEW to NEGOTIATING and does not create, close or alter a visit participation, terms, contacts, money facts, notification jobs or any other workflow state.

Use canonical path /api/v1/admin/inquiries/{inquiry_id}/commands with a normalized payload that identifies START_NEGOTIATION. Lock business_write_guard then the target inquiry. The inquiry expected_version is required and positive. A non-empty or malformed expected_visit_versions is EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED. Unknown/malformed inquiry id is NOT_FOUND. Only NEW is accepted; every other persisted status returns INVALID_TRANSITION without mutation.

On first acceptance increment only the inquiry version, write one OWNER change_event linked to the inquiry with a stable action name, write an owner receipt and receipt_inquiries link, and return the full stable result {command_id,inquiry,changed_visits:[]}. Use inquiry_detail_in_transaction before receipt storage so result semantics match the existing card. No visit version changes occur.

Preserve owner receipt semantics: HMAC idempotency digest, accepted exact replay without rereading later projection data, changed payload IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, tombstoned or malformed receipt RESULT_EXPIRED, and rejected requests do not consume the key. Expose safe failures only as OwnerCommandError; no persistence schema changes or diagnostics.

Add isolated disposable PostgreSQL tests for accepted transition and exact stable replay, every invalid source status, missing/stale versions and non-empty visit map, rejection atomicity and reusable key, malformed/unknown id, receipt/event/inquiry links, unchanged visit/participation state, mismatch and expiry. Never read local .env or a configured database.
Do not add HTTP routes, other inquiry commands, participation changes, payments, checkout, webhooks, notifications, migrations, frontend, bots, secrets or external calls.
acceptance: An owner command records the explicit NEW to NEGOTIATING transition and returns a stable full card result without modifying a calendar plan or financial history.
Versions, receipts and audit history prevent stale or duplicate negotiation transitions and partial state changes.
Focused isolated PostgreSQL tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Accepted narrow owner transition from NEW to NEGOTIATING with no participation, financial or HTTP change.
